title: Rockefeller serves breakfast and vows to get disclosure

tellings.quote: Rockefeller goes he he's talking Bud Hopkins told me a story he's there Jacobs and him are at uh him and Mack are at uh Rockefeller's house And Rockefeller is like a butler and he's taking bringing him breakfast and stuff like that. And they thought this is kind of weird this billionaires, you know, feeding us breakfast and stuff. And he he said, "I'm going to I'm going to get disclosure."

plain: In the 1990s, the billionaire Laurance Rockefeller hosted the UFO abduction researchers Budd Hopkins, David Jacobs and John Mack at his house, served them breakfast himself 'like a butler', and told them: 'I'm going to get disclosure', meaning he would get the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells it as a story Hopkins told him, adding that the guests found it odd to be fed by a billionaire. Cameron links it to the Rockefeller Initiative, Rockefeller's push for UFO openness, documented in government files released under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records.
